CaseOps dependency artifact repair

glob 14.0.2-caseops.1 retains the official glob 14.0.2 source, raw dist, types, and APIs.
Only the default CommonJS/ESM minified bundles and their maps were rebuilt using the upstream esbuild flags with exact fixed minimatch 11.0.1 and @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match 1.0.3 inputs.
Original archives and full bundled dependency attributions are identified in CASEOPS-BUNDLE-SOURCES.json and CASEOPS-BUNDLE-LICENSES.txt.
No network access or npm lifecycle is used during rebuilding.
